hash.same: Identical inputs always produce identical hashes. That is what makes hashes useful for checking integrity.
hash.diff: <0>{{diff}} of 256</0> SHA-256 bits differ ({{pct}}%). A tiny change to the input flips about half the output bits: the avalanche effect.

cipher.aesIntro: AES-256-GCM. The same secret encrypts and decrypts. Your password is stretched into a key with PBKDF2.
cipher.ciphertext: Ciphertext (salt.iv.data, Base64). Try editing a character.
cipher.aesFailed: Decryption failed. The key is wrong or the ciphertext was changed. AES-GCM detects both.
cipher.rsaIntro: RSA-OAEP 2048. Anyone can encrypt with the public key; only the private key can decrypt.
cipher.privateKey: Private key: kept inside your browser and never shown. That is the point.
cipher.rsaMessage: Message (up to about 190 characters with this key size)

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: TechTeacher is free to use without an account. This page explains what is stored if you make one, and who helps run the site.

sections.heading: Without an account
items: Your progress, theme, language and level filter are saved only in your own browser. Nothing about them is sent to us.

sections.heading: With an account, we store
items: Your password, scrambled with a one-way hash. We never see or store the password itself.
Which lessons you have completed, and an activity log of lessons you opened or marked done, with the time.
For each signed-in device: the IP address and browser type, used to keep you signed in and to spot misuse.

sections.heading: What we never do
items: No ads, no tracking or analytics cookies, and we never sell or share your data.
The only cookie is the one that keeps you signed in.

sections.heading: Services that help run the site
items: Cloudflare hosts the site and database. Its Turnstile check on the sign-in forms looks at browser signals to tell people from bots, and its Web Analytics counts page visits without cookies or tracking individuals.
Resend delivers account emails (confirmation and password reset), so it receives your email address.
Google Fonts serves the typeface, so your browser contacts Google when the page loads.

sections.heading: How long we keep it
items: Until you delete your account. Deleting it from the Account page removes your account, progress and activity at once.
Copies may remain in short-term database backups and Cloudflare request logs for up to 30 days before they expire.
Sign-ins expire after 30 days without a visit.
